description: This file contains unit tests for the HealthDecode functionality in the OpenClaw project, specifically testing JSON decoding of health snapshot data from various input scenarios.

classes.name: HealthDecodeTests
classes.description: A struct containing unit tests for decoding health snapshot JSON data, verifying proper parsing and error handling.

methods.name: `decodes clean JSON`
methods.description: Tests decoding of well-formed JSON data representing a health snapshot.

methods.name: `decodes with leading noise`
methods.description: Tests decoding of JSON data that is prefixed with noise or logs, ensuring robustness.

methods.name: `fails without braces`
methods.description: Tests decoding failure when the input data is not valid JSON.
